history.summary: THIS IS A JAIN TEMPLE (Digambar sect), NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. The temple stands inside the Digambar Jain Society at Saray Mohalla on Civil Road, Rohtak, and serves as the main Digambar Jain religious and cultural centre of the city. Lord Mahavir is installed as the Mulnayak across 9 vedis (idol platforms). The complex includes a Tyagi Nivas dharamshala, a Jain bhojanalaya, library and school. No founding date, builder, or architectural history found in any source.

town_description: Rohtak is a major city in Haryana, about 70 km from Delhi, and an important education and commercial hub of the state, home to Maharshi Dayanand University. The city has ancient roots, with nearby archaeological sites at Khokhra Kot linked to the Indus Valley and later periods. It is well connected by rail and road on the Delhi-Hisar corridor.
